text.zh: 一口饭的冒险从舌头开始：八块肌肉组成的"多面手"把食物搅拌成团，推向咽喉。
text.en: A bite's adventure begins at the tongue — eight muscles knead food into a ball and push it back.

text.zh: 搅拌的同时，口底两侧的腺体正把唾液送进来。淀粉的分解其实在嘴里就已经开始了。
text.en: While it churns, glands under the floor of the mouth are already feeding in saliva. The breakdown of starch begins before the food has even left your mouth.

text.zh: 食管接手：这条 25 厘米的肌肉滑梯用波浪式收缩把食物送进胃里——就算倒立，饭也照样能咽下去。
text.en: The esophagus takes over, squeezing food downward in waves — it works even upside-down.

text.zh: 咽下去那一下不是靠重力。咽壁上三对环形的肌肉一层接一层地从上往下收紧，把这口食物推走。
text.en: Swallowing is not gravity doing the work. Three rings of muscle in the wall of the throat tighten one after another from the top down, pushing the mouthful on its way.

text.zh: 胃是一台搅拌机，里面泡着 pH 一点五上下的稀盐酸。胃壁受得住，是因为它每隔几天就换一层新的黏膜。
text.en: The stomach is a mixer holding dilute hydrochloric acid at around pH 1.5. Its wall survives because it grows itself a fresh lining every few days.

text.zh: 两位幕后帮手上场：肝脏分泌胆汁乳化油脂，胰腺送来消化酶分解蛋白质和淀粉。
text.en: Two helpers join in: the liver sends bile to break down fat, while the pancreas delivers digestive enzymes.

text.zh: 重头戏在小肠。五到七米的管子盘在肚子中央，内壁一点都不光滑：褶皱上长绒毛、绒毛上再长微绒毛，一层层放大，才够把一顿饭拆成分子交给血液。
text.en: The main act is the small intestine: five to seven metres coiled through the middle of your belly. Its lining is anything but smooth — folds carry villi, villi carry microvilli, and only that stacking gives enough surface to hand a whole meal to the blood, molecule by molecule.

text.zh: 吸收到的营养不会直接进入全身循环。肝门静脉先把它们全部押送进肝脏——先查一遍、改一遍，剩下的才放行。
text.en: Absorbed nutrients don't join the general circulation right away. The hepatic portal vein marches them all into the liver first — checked and rebuilt there before anything is released.

text.zh: 最后一站大肠：回收水分、聚集菌群，残渣变成粪便排出体外。整趟旅程走完，大约要 一到两天。
text.en: Last stop, the large intestine: water is reclaimed and what remains leaves the body — the full trip takes a day or two.
